shape.notes: Four slots go to finishing the weekday set the user started (R-EX-05 / R-SEL-04); weekdays are time words, not concrete nouns, and are declared as a closed set. Remaining six slots claim building blocks in R-SEL-05 order. Spanish has no grammatically closed modal class, so querer/poder are claimed as spine verbs, not as a declared set. Must, go/future, have and pronouns are deferred to the next set.
